description: This file defines the KafkaSourceRDD class and related classes for reading data from Kafka within Apache Spark, including partitioning, offset management, and data consumption logic.

classes.name: KafkaSourceRDDPartition
classes.description: Partition class for KafkaSourceRDD, representing a specific offset range within a Kafka topic partition.

classes.name: KafkaSourceRDD
classes.description: An RDD implementation for reading data from Kafka based on specified offset ranges, with support for preferred locations and offset resolution.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Overrides the persist method to log an error about Kafka ConsumerRecord serialization issues.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Returns an array of KafkaSourceRDDPartition objects based on the offset ranges.

methods.name: getPreferredLocations
methods.description: Returns preferred executor locations for a given partition based on the offset range's preferred location.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Creates an iterator over Kafka ConsumerRecords for a given partition, handling offset range resolution and data fetching.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Resolves the actual offset range to use, handling negative offsets by querying Kafka for available offsets.
